newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - EUROPEAN DRUG ADRS TRADE LOWER.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - EUROPEAN DRUG ADRS TRADE LOWER.

text.p: European pharmaceuticals were following their U.S. counterparts lower as major patent expirations loomed for the sector in the United States, traders said Tuesday.
Glaxo Wellcome Plc saw its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) off 7/16 at 40-9/16, Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc was down 12/16 at 35-13/16, but SmithKline Beecham Plc was up 10/16 at 90-13/16.
One dealer said SmithKline was bucking the trend as U.S. bargain hunters were buying up the stock following its fall in London.
Meanwhile, Canadian foreign stock Draxis Health Inc was up 5/16 at 2-9/16.
Several Chinese companies ranked as leading percentage gainers on the New York Stock Exchange on low volumes.
Another trader said their ADRs were likely reacting to active trading in Hong Kong.
"There are rumors about asset injection from China," she said. "But they (the rumors) are not very specific."
Beijing Yanhua Petrochemical Co Ltd was up 3-7/8 at 17-3/4, Jilin Chemical Industrial Co was 3-3/8 higher at 29-1/8, Shanghai Petroleum was up 4 at 39-1/8, while China East Air was 2-1/2 up at 31.
Mexico's telephone company Telefonos de Mexico was down 3/16 at 52-7/8 in active trade following the resignation of a senior official at the country's most profitable banking group.
The official is the brother of Jaime Chico Pardo, director-general of Telmex, which raised speculation that he too might resign along. A source at Inbursa denied the Telmex chief was leaving.
"Some people might try to sell Telmex short," a dealer said.
Advancers led decliners 254 to 240 among 814 ADRs.
The ADR group was up 0.16 percent on a volume of 38.3 million ADRs.
